title: The sparsification theorem of Batson, Spielman and Srivastava
summary: Let (Ω, μ) be a measure space and a = (a_k) a family of m square-integrable functions whose Gram matrix ∫ a a* dμ is the identity. Then for every n ≥ m there are points x₁, …, xₙ ∈ Ω and weights w₁, …, wₙ > 0 with (1 − √((m−1)/n))² I ≼ ∑ᵢ wᵢ a(xᵢ) a(xᵢ)* ≼ (1 + √((m−1)/n))² I in the Loewner order.
